question: Are any currently open Stellar RFPs relevant to smart accounts or passkeys, and how do the returned briefs differ?

golden.answer: Fetch the full current open set with scout.getRfps({status:"open"}), then locally filter titles, descriptions, and technical requirements for related passkey and smart-account concepts. A q-filtered call may supplement but not replace the exhaustive open-set scan. Cite deliverables and dated round metadata. Cross-check brief status against the official SCF RFP Track page and flag any disagreement in either direction, including a returned brief it no longer lists or an official brief the live set omits. Do not infer that a matching open brief proves an SCF full-proposal window is open.
keyFacts: Fetches the full open RFP set first for local passkey/smart-account filtering.
Compares stated deliverables and cites each reported brief.
Includes round as-of/verifyAt and scopes an empty result to the source.
Separates brief status from the SCF round submission phase.
Cross-checks brief status against the official RFP Track page or flags it unverified.
avoid: Claims a remembered passkey brief is still open without current status evidence.
A narrow zero/one-hit query is not an exhaustive opportunity scan.
Claims that an open brief proves the current SCF round accepts a new full proposal.
Do NOT call a Scout-listed brief open now unless the answer attributes and dates that status.
golden.notes: Freshness item: As of 2026-11-12, the official RFP Track page lists two Q4 2026 briefs, published 2026-11-11: "Web and API Analytics for Stellar Ecosystem Projects" and "XDR/CAP-Coverage Audit Tool and Indexer-Hardening Guide". Scout still returns open=0 (activeQuarter q4-2026, briefRoster checkedOn 2026-11-04) and marks both former Q3 briefs closed, so it lags the official page; an answer that reports Scout’s empty set must date and attribute it and should flag the disagreement or mark the official cross-check unverified. No synthetic scf-round row appears: SCF #46 is in Initial Review after its 2026-11-09 submission deadline, and no submission window is open. Grade dated source-relative roster reporting, not a permanent absence claim. Re-query later sources and flag any new disagreement. A historical, attributed report of the former Q3 rows is acceptable; it is not current evidence that those briefs are open. Neither officially listed Q4 brief concerns passkeys or smart accounts, so a full open-set scan presently supports no open passkey or smart-account brief to compare. Reporting that scoped result meets the comparison fact; do not require invented deliverables. The historical Q3 briefs referenced custom __check_auth accounts but were not passkey briefs.
